title: Progress I have made on my game. Day 1 vs Day 52.
author: TheGrowthYardGaming
selftext:
It's available for free if anyone wants to try it. Still early in development but things are progressing and I am excited for the direction this is going. 

  
[https://play.sunspireresort.com/](https://play.sunspireresort.com/)

comments.author: nathanielx9
comments.body: Reminds me of the old sega casino game

replies.author: TheGrowthYardGaming
replies.body:
There was one called Casino Kid someone shared on another sub, it was from 1989. I had never heard of it but I can see how it's similar.   
  
  
What actually made me want to build this was I remember as a kid playing pokemon on gameboy and it having casinos inside of it. And my addiction to going to real casinos ha.

comments.author: human424242
comments.body: Looks awesome. Ai artwork? Even the pixelated art?

replies.author: TheGrowthYardGaming
replies.body: Yes I made it all with Claude Opus 5.5 and Fable. I have a pretty good system down to generate the type of art I want to work with. It does pretty good with pixel art if you know the right parameters.
